name: Kouhi Service
description: A calm landing theme for a workplace coffee service: a near-white ground, one muted brown and a single blue for actions, Plus Jakarta Sans over DM Sans. The home page opens on a rounded documentary photo banner with a notice strip, then a lifted centre card on a curved band with a round cup disc, a hanging utility tab in the header, 2x2 photo tiles, and a dated tasting calendar under pill tabs, ending in one booking call to action. Sample content in English: the home page, twelve inner pages and a journal with one article; other languages follow. Works without any plugin.
